AUTH_SECRET.description: Random secret for session cookies. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

GOOGLE_CLIENT_EMAIL.description: Service account email from the Google Cloud JSON key

GOOGLE_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Service account private key (with \n sequences). Required when CRM_DATA_BACKEND=sheets

SHEET_ID.description: Google Sheets spreadsheet ID. Required when CRM_DATA_BACKEND=sheets

SHEET_CACHE_TTL_MS.description: Sheets read cache TTL in milliseconds
